errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart. The categories of population groups are on the vertical axis, and the percentages are represented by the length of the horizontal bars along the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly swaps the axes.
The legend in the image indicates that the category 'Малко по-лесен' (A little easier) is represented by the color red, not light blue ('светло синьо').
The legend in the image indicates that the category 'Много по-труден' (Much harder) is represented by the color light blue/teal, not dark purple ('тъмно лилаво').
